Jason (API): Quick sync — we need a single, consumer-facing error surface that Console, API, and SDKs can rely on. Current state is messy across services.
Sophie (DevEx): Agree. Customers keep asking why some calls return 400 + 'invalid_prompt' vs 422 + 'validation_error' — confusing. :thinking:
Matt (Product): Main ask from PMs: friendly copy in Console + stable codes for retries. We can't change UI copy every time a microservice tweaks wording.
Elaine (SRE): From infra side, we need a strict enum for machine-readable fields so automation can route fallbacks. Human copy can be separate.
Kyle (Eng): Proposal: keep HTTP status semantics (4xx client, 5xx server) + add top-level "code" string (stable, consumer-facing id) + "explanation" (short user copy) + "meta" (opaque map). Example: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{
  "code": "quota_exceeded",
  "message": "Rate limit exceeded for embedding requests.",
  "detail": "Limit 60/min per token; retry in 60s",
  "meta": {"quota_window_seconds": "60", "resource": "embeddings"}
}
```
Sophie (DevEx): Love it. Two UX asks: 1) Console should render "message" but allow expanding "detail" for engineers; 2) show a consistent CTA (link to quota docs) when code == quota_exceeded.
Matt (Product): Also we should reserve a namespace for Redwood and customer error codes: e.g., "rw.quota_exceeded" vs "customer.rate_limit" so third-party errors don't collide.
Elaine (SRE): Prefer shorter codes for logs. Maybe keep machine id as "rw.quota_exceeded" and a short alias field for telemetry: "code": "quota_exceeded", "id": "rw.123.quota_exceeded"?
Kyle (Eng): I'd rather avoid numeric ids unless we map them in docs. Simpler to use dotted namespace: "rw.quota_exceeded" and that is both stable and unique.
Sophie (DevEx): Console copy owners: how do we handle localization? We should not embed long localized strings in responses. Return canonical English "message", and Console/localization pipeline translates it.
Jason (API): Good point. So spec: HTTP status, "code" (dotted stable string), "message" (short canonical EN), optional "detail" (technical), optional "help_url" (docs/KB). No free-form HTML.
UI Team: We need to know which fields are safe to render raw in the Console (message only). Everything else should be escaped.
Matt (Product): For retry semantics, include a standard "retry_after_seconds" when applicable. 429 should have it on the response and docs.
Elaine (SRE): For rollout UX: when fallback routing triggers (e.g., degraded model to cheaper variant), surface both original code and fallback info in telemetry but only show user-friendly message in Console like "Serving capacity limited — returning a lower-latency variant."
Kyle (Eng): Edge case: downstream services return nested errors (e.g., model-serving returns op-level error). We'll need a flattening rule in API gateway: prefer top-level "code" with provenance: "source": "model-serving" in meta.
Sophie (DevEx): Also let's standardize error categories for customers: validation, auth, quota, model, infra, usage. That will make Console filters and KB searchable.
Jason (API): Action items: 1) Draft error schema PR for API gateway (Kyle + Jason). 2) Console integration spec for rendering + CTA rules (Sophie + UI Team). 3) Telemetry mapping and retention story (Elaine). 4) Short doc for SDKs: mapping HTTP -> sdk exceptions (Matt).
Matt (Product): Timeline? We have a customer-facing webinar in 3 weeks; would love a preview for the Console.
Kyle (Eng): I'll open the draft PR today and tag people. Expect first cut by EOD.
Elaine (SRE): I'll sketch the telemetry mapping (error.code -> alert rules) and post here by tomorrow.
Sophie (DevEx): I'll draft the Console copy patterns (error banner, expandable details, CTA) and put a sample component in Figma.
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window tonight 02:00 UTC. If the API gateway change lands before that, notify infra.
Jason (API): Thanks everyone. Keeping the messages short in responses is critical — avoid long stack traces in "detail" unless user has verbose debug flag.
Sophie (DevEx): One more: add a deprecation policy header when codes change: Response header `X-Error-Code-Deprecation: rw.old_code->rw.new_code; expires=2026-05-01`. That gives SDKs time to adapt.
Kyle (Eng): Agree. We'll include header support in gateway.
Jason (API): Great. If nobody objects I'll start the PR and a small spec doc in the repo. :thumbsup:
Matt (Product): +1
Sophie (DevEx): +1 :sparkles:
Elaine (SRE): +1 :warning:
UI Team: LGTM
Jason (API): Filing follow-ups: PR link and RFC in #eng-platform when ready.
